definition.zh: 围绕复杂或陌生主题制定检索路径，从学术数据库、专业文献、开源社区、软件生态和多种公开渠道发现资料与工具。能够交叉比较来源、追溯原始信息、判断可靠性与合规性，并把分散内容整理为可用于创作、技术决策或学术写作的研究基础。
definition.en: Builds search strategies for complex or unfamiliar topics, discovering information and tools across academic databases, professional literature, open-source communities, software ecosystems and diverse public sources. Cross-checks evidence, traces original sources, evaluates reliability and compliance, and organises fragmented material into a foundation for creative work, technical decisions or academic writing.

definition.zh: 围绕研究问题建立论点与文本结构，进行文献检索、资料判断、论证组织、数据与案例整合、引用管理及中长篇学术文本写作。
definition.en: Frames research questions, arguments and document structures, integrating literature discovery, source evaluation, evidence, data, cases, citation management and extended academic writing.

definition.zh: 根据研究问题收集、整理、清理和分析数据，并使用图表与可视化解释结果。
definition.en: Collects, organises, cleans and analyses data around a research question, then communicates the results through charts and visualisation.

name.zh: 可持续时尚与产业研究

definition.zh: 了解可持续设计、可持续面料以及服装产业环保与可持续方面的知识，具有相关的管理和测算技能。
definition.en: Understands sustainable design, sustainable textiles, and environmental sustainability in the fashion industry, with related management and calculation skills.

definition.zh: 本科修读了高等数学A1/A2、线性代数B、概率论与数理统计B、数值分析、普通物理B、工程化学B、工程力学C、工程制图B、Python程序设计及实训、大数据分析与应用。
definition.en: Undergraduate coursework included Advanced Mathematics A1/A2, Linear Algebra B, Probability Theory and Mathematical Statistics B, Numerical Analysis, General Physics B, Engineering Chemistry B, Engineering Mechanics C, Engineering Drawing B, Python Programming and field practice, and Big Data Analysis and Application.

definition.zh: 本科修读了服装结构与人体工程、服装材料与性能测试、服装工艺、计算机辅助时装与样版设计、服装生产与质量管理、商品企划、渠道与终端管理、市场调查与数据分析、项目设计与管理、智能服装开发设计和服装人工智能技术等课程。
definition.en: Undergraduate coursework covered garment structure and ergonomics, fashion materials and performance testing, garment construction, computer-aided fashion and pattern design, fashion production and quality management, merchandise planning, channel and terminal management, market research and data analysis, project design and management, intelligent garment design, and garment artificial-intelligence technology.

definition.zh: 以艺术创作为核心，能够从概念、形式语言、媒介和语境发展作品。理解现代与当代艺术理论，能够结合观念和社会文化背景分析艺术作品，并将理论与批评性判断用于创作概念与方法的发展。
definition.en: Centres artistic practice, developing work through concepts, formal language, media and context. Understands modern and contemporary art theory, analyses artworks in relation to ideas and sociocultural backgrounds, and applies theoretical and critical judgement to the development of creative concepts and methods.

definition.zh: 把复杂问题拆解为目标、限制、资源和底层机制，不依赖惯例直接接受既有答案。能够从第一性原理重新建立推理链，比较不同方案的条件与后果，并把抽象判断转化为可验证的设计、研究或技术行动。
definition.en: Breaks complex problems into goals, constraints, resources and underlying mechanisms rather than accepting conventional answers at face value. Rebuilds reasoning from first principles, compares the conditions and consequences of alternatives, and translates abstract judgement into testable design, research or technical action.

definition.zh: 涵盖研究、概念设计、效果图、平裁、立裁、样版、样衣、缝纫、Fitting、修版和最终成衣的完整服装开发流程。
definition.en: Covers the complete garment-development process across research, concept design, illustration, flat cutting, draping, patterns, toiles, sewing, fitting, revision and final garments.

definition.zh: 把材料研究作为设计方法，而不仅是成品表面处理。能够操作手摇横机进行针织设计与制作，并运用草木染、纱线再造、面料改造、轻黏土和混合材料绘画等方式改变材料的结构、颜色、触感与叙事，使实验结果进一步进入服装、装置或视觉作品。
definition.en: Uses material research as a design method rather than treating it as surface decoration. Works with a hand flat knitting machine and applies botanical dyeing, yarn reconstruction, textile transformation, lightweight clay and mixed-media painting to alter structure, colour, tactility and narrative, carrying experimental outcomes into garments, installations or visual works.

definition.zh: 能够把首饰概念发展为成品，完整处理造型设计、塑形、干燥与烧制前准备、烧结收缩、镶嵌、修整、打磨、抛光和最终表面效果。也具有手工皮具制作经验，能够根据材料特性安排结构、加工顺序与细节完成度。
definition.en: Develops jewellery concepts into finished pieces, handling form design, shaping, drying and pre-firing preparation, sintering shrinkage, setting, refinement, sanding, polishing and final surface treatment. Also has leathercraft experience, planning structure, process order and detail according to material behaviour.

definition.zh: 建立影片的主题、叙事和视听方向，并协调剧本、镜头、表演、摄影、造型、声音与后期。
definition.en: Establishes a film's thematic, narrative and audiovisual direction while coordinating writing, shots, performance, cinematography, styling, sound and post-production.

definition.zh: 能够根据叙事、人物和空间选择镜头、构图、光线、机位与运动方式，完成静态摄影和动态影像拍摄。除操作摄影设备外，也能规划整体画面风格，并与导演、妆造和调色环节建立连续的视觉语言。
definition.en: Selects lenses, composition, lighting, camera position and movement according to narrative, character and space, working across still photography and moving-image capture. Beyond camera operation, plans the overall visual style and connects direction, styling and colour grading into a continuous visual language.

definition.zh: 把抽象概念、哲学命题或世界观发展为具有节奏和可执行性的叙事结构，进一步写成场景、人物行动、旁白和台词。写作不仅服务故事内容，也会考虑画面、声音、表演和剪辑如何共同传达信息，并延伸到歌词、短文与创意文本。
definition.en: Develops abstract concepts, philosophical propositions or world-building into paced, executable narrative structures, then into scenes, character actions, voice-over and dialogue. Writing considers how image, sound, performance and editing communicate together, and extends into lyrics, short prose and creative texts.

definition.zh: 从素材备份、命名、筛选和项目结构开始，建立可持续的后期工作流，并在DaVinci Resolve中完成剪辑、节奏调整、调色、特效、配音、AI变声及声音整合。理解不同编码格式、色彩空间和交付规格，也使用DaVinci Resolve Project Server支持局域网协作。
definition.en: Builds a sustainable post-production workflow from backup, naming, selection and project structure, then completes editing, pacing, colour grading, effects, voice work, AI voice transformation and sound integration in DaVinci Resolve. Understands codecs, colour spaces and delivery formats, and uses DaVinci Resolve Project Server for local-network collaboration.

definition.zh: 能够独立完成作词、作曲与编曲，从旋律、和声、节奏、音色和段落结构发展原创音乐。创作既包括独立歌曲，也能针对影片、表演或交互作品设计背景音乐与情绪推进，使音乐与叙事、画面和时间结构发生关系。
definition.en: Independently writes lyrics, composes and arranges original music through melody, harmony, rhythm, timbre and sectional structure. Work includes standalone songs as well as background music and emotional progression for film, performance or interactive projects, relating music to narrative, image and temporal structure.

definition.zh: 使用EQ、动态处理、空间、声像、音色和整体响度组织音乐、影片与交互作品中的声音。能够区分和配置电容麦、动圈麦等设备，理解音频信号链，并把声音分析参数进一步映射到视觉、3D模型、灯光或硬件控制中。
definition.en: Organises sound for music, film and interactive work through EQ, dynamics, space, panning, timbre and overall loudness. Selects and configures equipment such as condenser and dynamic microphones, understands audio signal chains, and maps analysed sound parameters onto visuals, 3D models, lighting or hardware control.

definition.zh: 涵盖常规建模、Geometry Nodes、雕刻、场景、材质、灯光、动画和渲染，也了解3D扫描、打印、材料与成本测算。
definition.en: Covers conventional modelling, Geometry Nodes, sculpting, scenes, materials, lighting, animation and rendering, with additional knowledge of 3D scanning, printing, materials and cost estimation.

definition.zh: 使用Processing、TouchDesigner、Three.js等工具把代码、数据和实时图形转化为视觉艺术、3D网页及交互体验。能够设计参数之间的映射关系，把用户输入、声音、传感器或网络数据转化为动态画面，并在浏览器、装置和表演环境中完成原型。
definition.en: Uses tools such as Processing, TouchDesigner and Three.js to translate code, data and real-time graphics into visual art, 3D websites and interactive experiences. Designs parameter mappings that transform user input, sound, sensors or network data into moving images, prototyping across browsers, installations and performance contexts.

definition.zh: 通过民族文化、宗教学、生物科学、社会议题和技术趋势研究，构建关于未来生活方式与价值系统的设计命题。能够把《千高原》等哲学概念转化为世界观、情境、物件或交互系统，运用Speculative Design与Provocative Design引发讨论，而不是只预测单一未来。
definition.en: Builds design propositions about future ways of living and value systems through research into culture, religion, biological science, social issues and technological change. Translates philosophical concepts such as A Thousand Plateaus into worlds, scenarios, objects or interactive systems, using speculative and provocative design to open debate rather than predict a single future.

definition.zh: 使用文生图、图生视频、文生视频、首尾帧和提示词工程生成影像，并将素材纳入剪辑、调色与后期流程。
definition.en: Uses text-to-image, image-to-video, text-to-video, first-and-last-frame generation and prompt engineering, integrating generated material into editing, colour grading and post-production.

definition.zh: 能够从信息架构、UI/UX和视觉语言出发，编写前端界面并连接数据、API与自动化流程，最终部署到Vercel和自定义域名。实践包含个人网站、3D交互网页、问卷系统与小型工具，重视跨设备响应式布局与移动端适配、可维护代码、版本管理和从概念到上线的完整闭环。
definition.en: Develops digital products from information architecture, UI/UX and visual language through frontend implementation, data and API integration, automation, and deployment to Vercel and custom domains. Practice includes a personal website, interactive 3D sites, survey systems and small utilities, with attention to cross-device responsive layouts and mobile adaptation, maintainable code, version control and the full path from concept to release.

definition.zh: 能够从日常使用中的具体痛点出发，界定工具的功能范围与交互逻辑，编写并测试可实际运行的软件，将个人需求转化为与操作系统或既有工作环境衔接的功能。也会使用版本管理记录开发过程，并把可发布版本维护在远端仓库。
definition.en: Turns specific points of friction in everyday use into a defined utility, its interaction logic and working, tested software. Translates personal requirements into functions that integrate with an operating system or existing work environment, while using version control to document development and maintain releasable versions in a remote repository.

definition.zh: 能够比较开源项目的功能、维护状态、依赖、许可证、文档与实施成本，阅读现有代码和配置，完成本地部署、问题定位与针对性修改，并把开源组件整合进网页、自动化工具或创意技术项目。
definition.en: Compares open-source projects by functionality, maintenance, dependencies, licences, documentation and implementation cost. Reads existing code and configuration, deploys locally, diagnoses issues, makes targeted modifications and integrates open-source components into websites, automation utilities or creative-technology projects.

definition.zh: 能够调用语言模型和生成式模型API，设计输入输出结构，并将模型能力接入网站、Unity程序与自动化工作流。也会使用AI Agent和不同MCP服务连接本地文件、软件与资料库，使模型输出参与内容生成、数据处理、交互逻辑和项目归档，而不只停留在聊天界面使用。
definition.en: Calls language-model and generative-model APIs, designs input/output structures and integrates model capabilities into websites, Unity applications and automated workflows. Uses AI agents and multiple MCP services to connect local files, software and libraries, allowing model output to participate in content generation, data processing, interaction logic and project archiving rather than remaining confined to chat interfaces.

definition.zh: 能够在视觉、音频、程序、微控制器与外部硬件之间建立实时通信，规划消息与参数映射，配置端口和波特率，解析数据并排查延迟或连接问题。
definition.en: Builds real-time communication among visual, audio, software, microcontroller and external hardware systems, planning messages and parameter mappings, configuring ports and baud rates, parsing data and diagnosing latency or connection issues.

definition.zh: 使用Arduino、ESP32和STM32连接传感器、灯光与执行部件，涉及基础电路、焊接、串口通信和控制逻辑，并可与TouchDesigner或Unity等软件交互。
definition.en: Uses Arduino, ESP32 and STM32 with sensors, lighting and actuators, covering basic circuitry, soldering, serial communication and control logic, with connections to software such as TouchDesigner and Unity.

definition.zh: 根据用途与预算选择CPU、主板、内存、显卡、电源、散热和存储，判断尺寸、功耗与接口兼容性，并完成普通或ITX主机的装配、散热布局、理线、升级和系统安装。
definition.en: Selects CPUs, motherboards, memory, graphics, power, cooling and storage according to purpose and budget; checks dimensions, power and interface compatibility; and assembles, cools, cables, upgrades and installs standard or ITX systems.

definition.zh: 在Linux与VPS上部署服务，并配置NAS、软路由、虚拟机、远程访问、影视库、多端备份、文件系统和Mac/Windows跨平台存储。
definition.en: Deploys services on Linux and VPS infrastructure and configures NAS, soft routing, virtual machines, remote access, media libraries, multi-location backup, file systems and cross-platform storage for macOS and Windows.

definition.zh: 根据电源、接口、机械结构和基础电路判断问题，能够拆装电脑、键盘、家具与小型电器，并进行系统修复、零件替换、焊接和电池更换。
definition.en: Diagnoses issues through power, interfaces, mechanical structure and basic circuitry, and works with computers, keyboards, furniture and small appliances through system repair, part replacement, soldering and battery changes.

definition.zh: 根据声音来源、空间和用途选择麦克风，规划前级、接口、监听、录制软件与输出之间的信号链。能够判断电平与噪声问题，并通过摆位、吸声和反射控制进行基础声学处理。
definition.en: Selects microphones according to source, space and purpose, planning signal flow across preamps, interfaces, monitoring, recording software and output. Diagnoses level and noise issues and applies basic acoustic treatment through positioning, absorption and reflection control.

definition.zh: 能够在时尚、影像、音乐、表演和技术人员之间翻译不同专业的语言，把抽象创意转化为可讨论的Reference、镜头、声音、材料和技术需求。既能独立承担多种角色，也能在团队中明确职责、交换素材、回应限制并保持整体概念一致。
definition.en: Translates between the languages of fashion, film, music, performance and technology, turning abstract ideas into discussable references, shots, sound, materials and technical requirements. Can take on multiple roles independently while also defining responsibilities, exchanging assets, responding to constraints and maintaining conceptual coherence in a team.

definition.zh: 能够向初学者讲解CLO3D界面、2D样版、缝合、3D模拟和基础输出，并结合服装结构进行示范与问题排查。
definition.en: Explains the CLO3D interface, 2D patterns, sewing, 3D simulation and basic output to beginners, supported by garment-structure demonstrations and troubleshooting.

definition.zh: 根据项目目标拆分研究、设计、拍摄、开发、后期、写作和发布阶段，安排人员、设备、素材、文件结构、版本和交付节点。在编程、艺术创作和论文写作中使用Zed浏览、阅读与组织项目，使用Codex协助管理和执行任务，并通过GitHub进行版本管理与远端备份，在关键节点推送可恢复版本。也能使用DaVinci Resolve Project Server和自动化工具支持多人协作、局域网后期与持续部署，降低素材丢失和版本混乱。
definition.en: Breaks project goals into research, design, shooting, development, post-production, writing and release phases, coordinating people, equipment, assets, file structures, versions and delivery points. Across programming, artistic practice and academic writing, uses Zed to browse, read and organise projects, Codex to support task management and execution, and GitHub for version control and remote backup, pushing recoverable versions at key milestones. Also uses DaVinci Resolve Project Server and automation to support collaboration, local-network post-production and continuous deployment while reducing asset loss and version confusion.

definition.zh: 围绕实际问题快速建立学习路径，主动寻找文档、论文、开源代码、课程和社区经验，并通过小型实验验证理解。长期追踪AI与新兴技术，也能把服装、声音、3D、硬件、研究和编程中的原理相互迁移，形成个人Wiki、Zotero与AI Agent结合的持续知识系统。
definition.en: Builds learning paths around practical problems, actively finding documentation, papers, open-source code, courses and community knowledge, then testing understanding through small experiments. Continuously follows AI and emerging technology, transfers principles among fashion, sound, 3D, hardware, research and programming, and maintains an evolving knowledge system combining a personal Wiki, Zotero and AI agents.

definition.zh: 长期进行健身、有氧、跑步和骑行，也会打乒乓球，并重视睡眠与恢复。
definition.en: Maintains long-term fitness, aerobic exercise, running and cycling, also plays table tennis, and values sleep and recovery.

definition.zh: 具备日常道路驾驶和海外自驾经验。
definition.en: Experienced in everyday driving and international self-drive travel.

definition.zh: 能够独立完成目的地调研、交通住宿比较、路线与预算规划、物资准备、风险判断和跨文化适应，并把复杂行政要求转化为有序的文件与时间计划。
definition.en: Independently handles destination research, transport and accommodation comparison, route and budget planning, packing, risk judgement and cross-cultural adaptation, translating complex administrative requirements into organised files and timelines.

definition.zh: 长期进行多类型烹饪，了解食材搭配，并对食物、茶和酒的风味具有较多体验。
definition.en: Has experience across multiple forms of cooking, ingredient pairing, and the flavours of food, tea and alcohol.

definition.zh: 了解不同咖啡器具和萃取方式，会根据豆子与器具调整研磨、粉水比和萃取。
definition.en: Understands different coffee tools and extraction methods, adjusting grind, ratio and extraction for the beans and equipment in use.

definition.zh: 围棋涉及局部计算、全局形势判断和长期方向选择。
definition.en: Go involves local calculation, global positional judgement and long-term strategic direction.

definition.zh: 会使用灭火器。
definition.en: Can use a fire extinguisher.

definition.zh: 把服装设计、面料改造、人体活动与嵌入式硬件放在同一系统中思考，使用Arduino等微控制器连接灯光、传感器与控制逻辑。能够处理电路隐藏、重量、供电、活动空间和视觉效果之间的平衡，使技术真正进入服装结构，而不是作为外加装饰。
definition.en: Treats fashion design, textile transformation, bodily movement and embedded hardware as one system, using microcontrollers such as Arduino to connect lighting, sensors and control logic. Balances circuit concealment, weight, power, movement and visual effect so technology becomes part of the garment structure rather than an attached decoration.

definition.zh: 将声音的频率、音量、节奏和动态变化映射到TouchDesigner或Unity中的3D模型、材质、动画与视觉参数。
definition.en: Maps frequency, volume, rhythm and dynamic change in sound onto 3D models, materials, animation and visual parameters in TouchDesigner or Unity.

definition.zh: 从表演时间线和观众体验出发，综合考虑配音、混音、背景音乐、音效、灯光、实时视觉、硬件输入与表演动作。能够利用TouchDesigner、OSC、MIDI和音频分析协调不同系统，使技术提示、舞台节奏和叙事变化保持同步，并具有少量实际舞台演出经验。
definition.en: Approaches performance through timeline and audience experience, coordinating voice, mixing, background music, effects, lighting, real-time visuals, hardware input and performer action. Uses TouchDesigner, OSC, MIDI and audio analysis to synchronise technical cues, stage rhythm and narrative change, supported by some practical stage-performance experience.

definition.zh: 把用户输入、数据处理、AI生成、版本管理、前端更新和网站部署连接为自动化流程。
definition.en: Connects user input, data processing, AI generation, version control, frontend updates and web deployment into an automated workflow.

definition.zh: 把阅读资料、引用、研究笔记和写作上下文组织为可追溯的个人知识系统，使AI Agent辅助学术写作时仍保留来源与知识结构。
definition.en: Organises readings, citations, research notes and writing context into a traceable personal knowledge system, allowing AI agents to assist academic writing while preserving sources and knowledge structure.

definition.zh: 将折纸的折线、展开方式和体积变化转化为服装廓形、样版与可活动结构。
definition.en: Translates origami folds, unfolding methods and volumetric changes into garment silhouettes, patterns and articulated structures.
